## Implemented controls versus remaining boundaries

| Area | Verified implementation and executed evidence | Limit / remaining owner |
|---|---|---|
| H04 content-bound lineage | `exact`, `blob`, `safe_path`, `validate_data`: typed registry/path/ID/version/digest checks; raw/parser/normalizer/config references; recursive parent checks. Positive frozen fixture and missing/altered/wrong-type/path tests pass. | Checks bytes and declared relationships, not remote truth or arbitrary parser correctness. Quant owns complete reproduction. |
| H04 temporal integrity | Observations require bound availability evidence; capture cannot backdate availability; publication/correction ordering enforced. Features inherit latest parent availability and evaluation role restrictions. Decision manifests deny unknown/late/evaluation inputs. Synthetic corrected-version and leakage regressions pass. | Archived publication truth is not authenticated. General code execution and result reproduction are not implemented. |
| H05 membership primitives | Namespace/event/outcome canonical keys, sorted membership digest, same identities after dataset rename, overlap intersection and frozen row assembly verified. | Honest upstream canonical identity mapping assumed. No prior-exposure/freeze protocol or confirmation contamination decision; Research/Quant remain responsible. |
| H06 history | `verify_history` verifies exact full Git SHA and immutable-prefix bytes; mutation/deletion, missing/movable baseline, changed inventory, orphan/cyclic supersession and checkpoint mismatch tests pass. Valid correction preserves originals. | Caller must supply trusted baseline. No external trust provisioned; baseline-free API is structural only. CLI default protects initial history, not automatically all later publications. |
| M01 registry | Identifier/filename/version agreement, contiguous versions, typed edges, supersession and handoff orphan/cycle checks; project-state shape/nonnegative count/LOCKED constraints verified. | Handoff edges do not prove completed prerequisite versions. Summary is not event-derived and its presence/references are not an operational safety guarantee. Risk/Director integration remains. |
| M02 time and permission | Injected aware clock rejects future completed facts. Typed source permission binds source, terms bytes, time, uses and expiry; invalid/expired/mismatched/altered evidence rejects. Old conceptual declarations and future scheduled events remain allowed. | Reviewer identity/remote terms truth unverified; operational freshness is Risk-owned. These checks do not authorize acquisition. |
| H03 quarantine primitives | Exact-path/global scope, dependency cycle/orphan checks, transitive closure and retained quarantine verified in isolated tests. | No integration with legacy free-text STOP records, resolution authority or operational eligibility. Risk-owned H03 remains open. |

Positive controls include deterministic test-authored parser/normalizer execution, typed frozen-fixture validation, valid correction with unchanged predecessor bytes, rename-stable membership, valid permission and expected quarantine sets. Negative controls cover missing/altered inputs, wrong types/identities, path aliases/escapes, unknown/late availability, evaluation leakage, future completed facts, invalid permissions, cycles/orphans and published-history mutation/deletion. These were executed, not inferred from prose.

`verify_history` independently passed against the prescribed review baseline (35 protected files) and against the frozen Data completion commit (62 protected files). Selecting the completion commit here is a read-only preservation comparison, not a newly approved operational checkpoint. These counts are distinct from the 38-file completion inventory. Skeptic's probe file is byte-identical to the review baseline. A writer controlling the verifier/baseline can defeat the assurance; no external trust claim is made.

Full tracebacks and independent machine-readable observations are in `reports/director-verification/`. Original Data logs and Skeptic tests are preserved. This is bounded evidence, not proof that no undiscovered defect exists.

Totals: **B = 10 entries in 7 methods; A = 2 entries in 2 methods**. H01 promotion produces four entries from one method. H02 same-actor approval and H03 arbitrary-file clearance still pass unsafe-acceptance probes; neither is fixed, and both are explicitly Risk-owned. The remaining four original methods continue to pass existing structural/capital controls.

No genuine regression was demonstrated by the reproduced errors. However, B-class errors alter which attacks are exercised. Data's own classification is candid but cannot supply the required independent disposition. The plan permits *documented expected characterization mismatches* for dependent remediation, but also requires Skeptic consultation for disputed probes or permanent suite changes. Here the Director withholds acceptance of fixture-blocked coverage pending that consultation. No permanent suite migration or exception is authorized.
